headline: GOLD HOLDS $4,155 WITH US MARKETS DARK FOR JUNETEENTH — SILVER EXTENDS LOSSES TO $64.69 AS FOMC HAWKISH HOLD AND DOLLAR STRENGTH PERSIST
snippet: Spot gold traded at approximately $4,154.70, down 1.28%, and spot silver fell to $64.69, down 1.35%, on June 19, 2026, as U.S. markets closed for the Juneteenth holiday and trading continued in London and Asia with no American institutional counterweight to absorb the continued selling pressure from the Fed's hawkish hold. The drivers remain unchanged from Thursday's FOMC-triggered selloff: Chair Warsh's first meeting produced a split dot plot that sent October rate-hike odds above 70%, the U.S. Dollar Index remains near its highest level since May 2025, and the geopolitical risk premium that briefly supported precious metals mid-week — from the US-Iran Strait of Hormuz interim agreement — has fully faded. Silver is now approximately 46% below its January 28 all-time high of $121/oz; gold is approximately 26% below the January $5,589 ATH. TSX and ASX-listed gold and silver mining stocks traded modestly lower in thin holiday-week volume with no New York price discovery until Monday. The first US trading session post-Juneteenth will be closely watched for whether institutional buyers step in at current levels or whether dollar strength continues to press the complex deeper into what seasonal data identifies as the typical mid-June trough zone for gold stocks.

headline: ENDEAVOUR SILVER DRILLS 282 g/t Ag + 6.3 g/t Au AT PRODUCING TERRONERA — FIRST EXPLORATION SINCE 2020 OPENS LIFE-BEYOND-TEN-YEARS THESIS
source_name: Investing News Network / Endeavour Silver Corp. (TSX: EDR, NYSE: EXK)
snippet: Endeavour Silver Corp. (TSX: EDR) announced June 18, 2026 high-grade results from its first exploration drilling campaign at the Terronera silver-gold mine in Jalisco, Mexico since 2020 — targeting both the Terronera vein and the adjacent La Luz vein system with two rigs now running through mid-Q4 2026. Hole TRU-001 returned 10 metres grading 282 g/t Ag and 1.8 g/t Au from 121 metres depth; TRU-003 intersected 9 metres of 150 g/t Ag and 6.3 g/t Au from 109 metres; the La Luz system's standout hole LL-43 delivered 574 g/t Ag and 23.92 g/t Au over 1.06 metres true width — equivalent to 2,607 g/t AgEq. National Bank Financial mining analyst John Hayes described the results as 'strongly supportive of Terronera's resource growth and mine life extension potential, with high-grade results at La Luz a particular highlight.' Terronera, which achieved commercial production in October 2025, carries a 10-year published mine life — but these exploration intercepts, extending mineralization along strike and at depth beyond the existing mine plan, demonstrate that the 10-year figure is a floor rather than a ceiling. For silver mining investors holding EDR through the current 46% correction from silver's January ATH, mine-life extension results from a new producing mine represent one of the few catalysts capable of re-rating the stock independently of the metal price.

headline: HUDBAY BREAKS GROUND ON NEW INGERBELLE — COPPER MOUNTAIN MINE LIFE EXTENDED BEYOND 2040 WITH 750,000T Cu, 800+ JOBS SECURED IN BC
source_name: Canadian Mining Journal / Hudbay Minerals Inc. (TSX: HBM, NYSE: HBM)
snippet: Hudbay Minerals Inc. (TSX/NYSE: HBM) celebrated the official groundbreaking of the New Ingerbelle expansion project at its Copper Mountain Mine in the Similkameen Valley of southern British Columbia on June 18, 2026, attended by BC's Minister of Mining and Critical Minerals, the Chief of the Upper Similkameen Indian Band, and the BC Mining Association — a rare alignment of provincial government, Indigenous, and industry endorsement for a copper mine expansion. New Ingerbelle is expected to extend Copper Mountain Mine's operating life beyond 2040 with a stripping ratio approximately three times lower than current mining areas, and the ore body carries estimated recoverable reserves of approximately 750,000 tonnes of copper, 900,000 oz of gold, and 5.5 million oz of silver over the expansion's mine life, securing more than 800 full-time jobs in the Similkameen Valley into the 2040s. The groundbreaking follows key mining permits received in February 2026 after a robust consultation process. With the US Commerce Secretary facing a June 30, 2026 deadline on potential Section 232 tariffs of 15-30% on imported refined copper, the official start of a large-scale BC copper mine expansion is concrete evidence that North American copper supply-chain policy is already drawing capital and accelerating mine development ahead of a potential tariff regime — the investment thesis for domestic copper producers playing out in physical form at the Similkameen copper belt.

headline: PUREPOINT + ISOENERGY DRILL INTO NOVA — 3,150m SUMMER EXPANSION OF 8.1% U3O8 ATHABASCA CORRIDOR ADJACENT TO HURRICANE DEPOSIT
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Purepoint Uranium Group Inc. (TSXV: PTU) + IsoEnergy Ltd. (TSX: ISO)
snippet: Purepoint Uranium Group Inc. (TSXV: PTU) and IsoEnergy Ltd. (TSX: ISO) announced June 17, 2026 the commencement of a 3,150-metre, 7-hole summer drilling program at the Nova Discovery within their 50/50 Dorado Project joint venture in Saskatchewan's eastern Athabasca Basin — a 98,000-hectare position immediately adjacent to IsoEnergy's Hurricane deposit, the world's highest-grade indicated uranium resource at an average grade of 34.5% U3O8. Winter 2026 drilling at Nova expanded uranium mineralization across a 1-kilometre structural corridor with a peak radioactivity of 73,100 cps and assays returning up to 8.1% U3O8 — among the highest-grade basement-hosted results in the eastern Basin in the current cycle. The summer program, running July through August, tests strike and dip extensions of the Nova corridor from multiple directions and evaluates additional high-priority regional targets across the broader Dorado Project. IsoEnergy's established geological track record at Hurricane, combined with its 50% JV stake in the Dorado Project, represents meaningful institutional validation of the target model — and a 1-km corridor with 8.1% peak U3O8 grades in the world's highest-grade uranium district, adjacent to the world's best-grade indicated resource, is the kind of discovery context that generates the most significant re-ratings for basin-scale uranium juniors once the summer assay campaign delivers.

headline: COSA + DENISON LAUNCH MURPHY LAKE NORTH'S LARGEST EVER URANIUM DRILL — 6,000m FOLLOWS 5.0m AT 0.55% U3O8 HIT, 3km FROM HURRICANE
source_name: Investing News Network / Cosa Resources Corp. (TSXV: COSA)
snippet: Cosa Resources Corp. (TSXV: COSA) announced June 18, 2026 that diamond drilling has commenced at the Murphy Lake North uranium joint venture — its largest program to date at 6,000 metres across 15 holes, with Cosa operating at 70% interest and Denison Mines Corp. participating at 30%. The program targets systematic follow-up of uranium mineralization intersected during Winter 2026: a 5.0-metre zone grading 0.55% U3O8 within an extensive structural and alteration corridor approximately 265 metres below surface, defined on 600 metres of open strike in both directions. Murphy Lake North is located 3 kilometres east of IsoEnergy's Hurricane deposit in Saskatchewan's eastern Athabasca Basin. Denison's 30% participation provides dual validation — geological (Denison's Athabasca exploration track record includes the Wheeler River Feasibility Study) and financial (a major allocating capital to a junior's program signals genuine technical conviction in the target). With uranium spot near $86/lb and US utilities under-contracted through the early 2030s, a 5.0m at 0.55% U3O8 zone open 600m along strike — between the world's highest-grade indicated resource (Hurricane) and producing Athabasca mines — is precisely the kind of high-impact summer drill target that moves small-cap uranium stocks ahead of assay results.

headline: SOMA GOLD CLEARS FINAL PERMIT — AURORA AND EL LIMON COLOMBIA MINES COMMENCE DELIVERIES TO EL BAGRE GOLD COMPLEX
source_name: Mining Technology / Soma Gold Corp. (TSXV: SOMA)
snippet: Soma Gold Corp. (TSXV: SOMA) announced June 18, 2026 that the Explosives Permit — the final regulatory approval required to resume operations at the Aurora Mine in Antioquia, Colombia — has been granted, with shipments of mineralized material to the El Bagre Gold Complex commencing immediately. Simultaneously, mining at the adjacent El Limon Mine has commenced with deliveries to the El Bagre Mill also underway. Aurora, purchased by Soma in 2024 and fully rehabilitated with new power, ventilation, and hoisting systems, is targeted to ramp to permitted output of 20 tonnes per day. Both mines now feed the centralized El Bagre mill as part of Soma's hub-and-spoke strategy for its Antioquia portfolio — converting individually marginal smaller mines into an aggregated feed stream that justifies the fixed processing infrastructure. At the current gold price of approximately $4,155/oz, the permit receipt and first ore deliveries from a multi-mine Colombia gold junior that has been building infrastructure quietly through the price correction mark the transition from development-stage to production-stage — the re-rating event junior investors track in the current gold market where producers are generating record margins even at prices well below the January ATH.

headline: CPM GROUP: SILVER FACES $60 FLOOR TEST BEFORE NEXT BULL LEG — CONSOLIDATION EXPECTED FOR MONTHS AS FOMC HAWKISHNESS PERSISTS
snippet: Jeffrey Christian of CPM Group published a June 16, 2026 Kitco analysis arguing that silver's pullback to the mid-$60s is likely not yet complete — with a defined downside test to $60 per ounce, and in a more extreme scenario, a possible break below $50 before the metal forms a durable base for its next sustained advance. Christian's framework identifies four compounding forces driving silver lower: institutional profit-taking from January's peak, investor position liquidation, heavy flows of physical silver back into refineries from ETF redemptions, and the FOMC's hawkish hold creating a sustained dollar tailwind. CPM Group expects consolidation to continue for 'the next several months,' with the gold price testing the $4,100 area and potentially spiking toward $3,800 during a volatile consolidation — with silver tracking directionally in tandem and potentially overshooting to the downside. For junior silver mining investors, Christian's analysis provides a framework for managing position sizing and deployment timing: the consolidation phase may extend well into Q4 2026 before CPM Group's long-term structural silver bull thesis reasserts — suggesting the emphasis should be on high-quality assets with strong balance sheets that can sustain exploration through a multi-month consolidation, rather than leveraged or undercapitalized plays that require rapid price recovery.

headline: GOLDSEEK: GOLD STOCKS HIT MID-JUNE SEASONAL FLOOR — SUMMER DOLDRUMS '26 OVERSHOT SETS UP STRONGER-THAN-AVERAGE AUTUMN RALLY
snippet: Adam Hamilton of Zealllc, writing his annual Gold Summer Doldrums analysis for GoldSeek, argues that gold's 2026 summer setup is unusually bullish because January's speculative excess has been fully purged — and the current drawdown has already overshot the typical mid-June doldrums trough. In 22 confirmed gold bull years, the HUI gold stock index has averaged a decline of just 1.5% from its summer-entry level before bottoming in mid-June; in 2026, GDX was approximately 5% lower summer-to-date at the time of Hamilton's writing, meaning the sector has already absorbed more than three times the typical doldrums drawdown. Hamilton's seasonal data shows that autumn rallies in confirmed bull markets are proportional to the depth of the summer drawdown — a deeper-than-average correction leads to a stronger-than-average Q3-Q4 advance, which he describes as the pattern that produces the largest gains for patient investors who hold through summer weakness. With gold near $4,155 — 26% below the January $5,589 ATH but still approximately 85% above its 2024 pre-breakout levels — and GDX miners operating at near-record earnings per ounce despite depressed equity valuations, Hamilton's seasonal framework offers a timing anchor for the contrarian accumulation thesis: mid-June historically marks the best annual entry point for gold stocks before the autumn advance begins, and in 2026 that window has been extended by an unusually deep pre-summer correction.
